verdicts.reason: The two banners are almost identical, and both have the same problems. The red 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is crammed against the SOLSTICE logo and runs off the left edge. The bottle is shrunk to a tiny icon. The subcopy sits tight against the top edge. The legal text is too small to read and is jammed next to the CTA as a fourth stacked block, so the right side looks crowded. A's headline is larger and fills nearly the full height, which feels cramped but gives a clearer focal point. In B the ribbon overlaps and clips the 'SOLSTICE' logo text, and the headline breaks awkwardly after 'Make the', so B is slightly worse.
